features.title: How <1>FitWizard</1> Works
features.subtitle: Everything you need to create the perfect workout plan, all in one place.

smart_goals.title: Smart Goal Setting
smart_goals.description: Choose strength, hypertrophy, or general fitness goals

benefits: Science-backed periodization tailored to your specific goal
Automatic volume and intensity adjustment as you progress
Choose from strength, hypertrophy, or general fitness tracks
detail.how_it_works: Tell us your goal, and our algorithm builds a program using proven training principles. Want strength? We program lower reps with higher intensity. Chasing muscle growth? Optimal volume with progressive overload built in. Prefer general fitness? A balanced approach that covers all your bases.
detail.example: For hypertrophy, we program 10-20 sets per muscle group per week, with rep ranges of 8-12 and strategic RIR (Reps in Reserve) progression to maximize muscle stimulus while managing fatigue.

equipment.title: Equipment Matching
equipment.description: Plans tailored to your available equipment

benefits: No wasted exercises — every movement matches what you have
Seamlessly switch between home and gym workouts
Smart alternatives suggested when equipment isn't available
detail.how_it_works: Select your available equipment — from a full commercial gym to just a pair of dumbbells — and we filter our extensive exercise library to only show movements you can actually perform. Traveling? Update your equipment and get an instant program adjustment.
detail.example: Training at home with dumbbells only? We'll swap barbell bench press for dumbbell press, and leg press for goblet squats and lunges — same muscle groups, different tools.

pdf_export.title: PDF Export
pdf_export.description: Download and share your personalized plan

benefits: Take your workout anywhere — no internet required
Print-friendly format perfect for gym sessions
Share your plan with workout partners or coaches
detail.how_it_works: One click generates a beautifully formatted PDF with your complete workout plan, including exercises, sets, reps, rest periods, and coaching cues. Perfect for offline training or keeping a physical copy at your gym.
detail.example: Heading to a gym with no phone signal? Export your plan before you go and have every detail at your fingertips, from warm-up to cooldown.

trainer_mode.title: Coach Mode
trainer_mode.description: Manage clients and assign customized plans

benefits: Manage multiple clients from a single dashboard
Create and assign customized plans in minutes
Track client progress and workout adherence over time
detail.how_it_works: Switch to Coach Mode to unlock the coach dashboard. Add clients, generate personalized plans based on their individual goals and equipment, and monitor their workout completion. Add private notes only you can see.
detail.example: Managing 10 clients? Create unique programs for each based on their goals — strength for Alex, hypertrophy for Sam, general fitness for Jordan — all from one intuitive interface.

summary.title: In short
summary.p1: FitWizard works without an account. If you don't sign in, your training data is kept on your device and is not sent to us.
summary.p2: If you sign in, your training data is also saved to our cloud database so you can use it on other devices.
summary.p3: Some optional features send limited data to other services, and only after you turn them on. Each one is listed below. We do not sell your data, show ads, or track you across other apps and websites.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.intro: Depending on the features you use, FitWizard stores:
collect.training: Training data: workout plans, workout logs (sets, reps, weight and effort), a workout in progress, personal records, your current week and your preferred weight unit.
collect.nutrition: Nutrition data: the meals and foods you log, with calories and macros, and your nutrition profile (age, sex, height, weight, activity level, goal and water goal), targets, custom foods, favourite foods and saved meals.
collect.body: Body and recovery data: body measurements (such as body weight, body-fat percentage and tape measurements) and daily readiness check-ins (ratings for sleep quality, muscle soreness, energy and stress).
collect.progress: Progress and library data: achievements, badges and streaks, custom exercises you create, favourite exercises, collections, filter presets, recently viewed exercises and library settings. When you are signed in, we also record which exercises you view.
collect.setup: Setup answers: your answers in the plan wizard (goal, experience, equipment, muscles, schedule, and limits such as avoiding overhead work) and in onboarding (avatar, role and interests).
collect.account: Account data, if you sign in: your email address and a profile with a display name (taken from your email address) and your timezone. To sign in, we email you a link and a 6-digit code. The code is used once and is not stored by the app.
collect.settings: Settings and choices: your privacy choices, language, theme and similar settings, and the bookkeeping sync needs (which items changed and when, never their content).
collect.technical: Technical data: like any website, our hosting provider receives your IP address and browser or device details with every request.
collect.not_collected: FitWizard does not access your location, contacts, camera, photos, or health records from other apps.

storage.title: Where your data is stored
storage.device: On your device: in the app's own storage (IndexedDB in a browser, app storage files on iPhone and Android) and, for small settings, in browser storage. FitWizard adds no encryption of its own; your device's protections, such as a screen lock, apply.
storage.session: Your sign-in: when you sign in, a sign-in token from our authentication provider (Supabase) is saved on your device so you stay signed in after you close the app or browser. In a browser it's kept in this site's local storage; in the iPhone and Android apps it's kept in the app's private preferences. It identifies your session only and holds no workout or health data. Signing out deletes it from your device.
storage.cloud: In our cloud database, if you sign in: we use Supabase, and your data is stored in {{region}}. Each account can read and change only its own records.
storage.sync: What syncs: your plans, workout logs, personal records, nutrition logs and settings, body measurements, readiness check-ins, achievements, custom exercises and favourite exercises. The app syncs when you sign in, when your device comes back online, when you return to the app, and shortly after each change. Nothing is sent while you are offline or signed out; changes made while signed out are sent the next time you sign in.
storage.first_sign_in: The first time you sign in on a device, the app keeps your account's copy of any record that exists in both places, and uploads only the records that exist only on that device.
storage.sign_out: Signing out: the app syncs one last time, warns you if any changes haven't been backed up yet, and then erases your training data from the device. Your account keeps the synced copy.
storage.transfers: Some of the services listed below are in other countries, so your data may be processed outside the country where you live. Supabase, Vercel, Sentry and PostHog are companies based in the United States. Where your data leaves the European Economic Area or the UK, it is protected by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, as set out in each provider's data processing agreement. {{transfers}}

recipients.title: Who receives your data
recipients.intro: We share data only with the services that run FitWizard's features:
recipients.supabase: Supabase runs accounts, sign-in emails and the cloud database. It receives your email address, profile and synced data when you sign in.
recipients.vercel: Vercel (Vercel Inc.) hosts the app and our server functions. It receives your IP address and device details with every request. Usage statistics on the website (Vercel Web Analytics), only if you turn on "Share anonymous usage statistics": to count page visits and see which pages are used, it receives the page address and the page you came from, your browser, operating system and device type, and the country worked out from your IP address. It sets no cookies, and visits aren't linked to your IP address; to count unique visits it uses a hash of the request that resets every day. It isn't used in the iPhone and Android apps. Where: {{vercelRegion}}. How long: {{vercelRetention}}. It is off unless you turn it on, and turning the switch off in Profile → Details → Privacy Settings stops it straight away, with no reload.
recipients.open_food_facts: Open Food Facts provides food search, only if you turn on food lookup. It receives the barcode or search text and your IP address. Without food lookup, nothing is sent.
recipients.wger: wger provides the exercise catalogue. Catalogue and search requests go through our servers, so wger sees our server's address, not yours. Exercise pictures load directly from wger, so wger sees your IP address.
recipients.api_ninjas: API Ninjas provides a backup exercise search and the daily quote. Requests go through our servers, and it receives only the search text.
recipients.sentry: Crash reports (Sentry, from Functional Software, Inc.), only if you turn on "Send crash reports": to find and fix errors that break the app. Only when the app hits an error, Sentry receives the error message and stack trace, the part of the screen where it happened, the app version, your browser and operating system, and the page path without query strings. Crash reports never include your name, email address, account ID, cookies, or any workout, body, readiness or nutrition data. Sentry sees your IP address when a report arrives, but our project is set not to store it {{sentryIp}}. Where: Sentry's {{sentryRegion}} data region. How long: {{sentryRetention}}. It is off unless you turn it on, and turning it off in Profile → Details → Privacy Settings stops reporting straight away, with no reload.
recipients.posthog: Usage statistics (PostHog, from PostHog Inc.), only if you turn on "Share anonymous usage statistics": to learn which features people use, so we know what to improve. PostHog receives events without your name or email: which screens you open, and when you finish steps such as creating a plan, starting or finishing a workout, logging a meal or signing in. Events can include a few general details: your goal type, days per week, number of exercises, workout length in minutes, and whether you use the web, iPhone or Android app. They never include your name, email address, account ID, weights, reps, body measurements, readiness answers or what you eat. Page addresses are sent without query strings, and IDs and invite codes in them are removed. PostHog keeps a random identifier in the app's local storage to group events from one device; it is deleted when you turn usage statistics off. Session recording, automatic click tracking and surveys are off. PostHog sees your IP address when an event arrives, but our project is set not to store it {{posthogIp}}. Where: PostHog EU Cloud (Frankfurt, Germany). How long: {{posthogRetention}}. This is the same switch as Vercel Web Analytics; it is off unless you turn it on, and turning it off in Profile → Details → Privacy Settings stops sending straight away, with no reload.
recipients.app_stores: Apple and Google distribute the app and collect their own data under their own policies. Workout reminders and rest-timer alerts in the iPhone and Android apps are local notifications: the app schedules them on your device, only after you allow notifications, and nothing about them leaves your device. Your reminder settings stay on the device and are not synced.
recipients.off_features: Social circles and the coach portal are switched off and collect nothing. We will update this policy before turning either on.
recipients.no_sale: We do not sell or rent your data, and we do not share it for advertising.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.features: To provide the app: build plans, log workouts and meals, and show your history and progress. Without an account this happens only on your device. Legal basis: providing the service you asked for {{basis}}.
purposes.sync: To keep your data in your account and on your other devices, if you sign in. Because this includes health-related data (such as body measurements, readiness check-ins and nutrition), the legal basis is your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time {{basis}} {{syncConsent}}.
purposes.sign_in: To sign you in and keep your account secure. Legal basis: providing the service you asked for {{basis}}.
purposes.lookups: To look up foods and exercises when you ask. Food lookup is used only with your consent; exercise search sends no personal data {{basis}}.
purposes.crashes: To find and fix crashes, if you turn on crash reports. Legal basis: your consent {{basis}}.
purposes.analytics: To understand which parts of the app are used, if you turn on usage statistics. Legal basis: your consent {{basis}}.
purposes.abuse: To protect our server functions from abuse (see How long we keep it). Legal basis: our legitimate interest in keeping the service available and secure {{basis}}.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.device: On your device: until you delete it in the app, use Erase data on this device, clear the app's or the browser's data, or uninstall the app.
retention.cloud: In your account: until you delete it, or delete your account. When you delete a synced item, including a plan, its content is wiped from our servers straight away. Only a deletion marker stays (the item's ID, or for a daily log its date, and the time it was deleted), so that your other devices remove the item too; the marker is removed when you delete your account {{wipe}}. Your device keeps only your latest 20 plans, but older plans stay in your account.
retention.account: Your email address, your profile and the record of which exercises you viewed are kept until you delete your account.
retention.code: Sign-in codes work once and expire after a short time.
retention.session: The sign-in token on your device: until you sign out, delete your account, or clear the app's or the browser's data.
retention.ip: To limit each address to 60 requests a minute, our server functions keep your IP address in memory with a request count. They never write it to disk, log it or share it, but it can stay in memory until that server instance shuts down. Vercel's own request logs follow Vercel's policy.
retention.third_parties: Sentry keeps crash reports for {{sentryRetention}}. PostHog keeps usage events for {{posthogRetention}}, and Vercel Web Analytics keeps page-view statistics for {{vercelRetention}}. Open Food Facts, wger and API Ninjas keep what they receive under their own policies.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.consent: Privacy settings: choose separately whether to send crash reports, share anonymous usage statistics, and allow food lookup. All three are off unless you turn them on. Change them at any time in Profile → Details → Privacy Settings. Turning one off takes effect straight away. If you say no, that service receives nothing from you.
choices.export: Export: Profile → Details → Export Data (JSON) saves a file, in a common machine-readable format, with what the app keeps about you: plans (including a workout in progress), workout logs, personal records, nutrition logs and settings, body measurements, readiness check-ins, achievements, custom exercises, exercise favourites and collections, your wizard and onboarding answers, the date you agreed to these terms and your usage-statistics and food-lookup choices, and, if you are signed in, your account email and profile.
choices.delete_items: Delete items: you can delete plans, meals, custom foods, saved meals and body measurements in the app. If you are signed in, the item's content is wiped from our servers straight away, and only a deletion marker stays so your other devices remove it too {{wipe}}.
choices.guest: No account: use FitWizard without signing in, and your training data stays on your device. To remove it, use Profile → Details → Erase data on this device.
choices.rights: Your rights: depending on where you live (for example in the EU, the UK or some US states), you can ask to see your data, correct it, delete it or get a copy of it, ask us to limit or stop using it, and withdraw any consent at any time (this doesn't affect what was done before). You can do much of this yourself in the app: export, edit, delete items, or delete your account. For anything else, email {{email}}; we reply within one month. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.

delete_account.title: Delete your account
delete_account.intro: You can delete your account and your data at any time.
delete_account.in_app: In the app: open Profile, go to Details, tap Delete account, type DELETE and confirm. This permanently deletes your account and everything stored with it on our servers: your email address and profile, plans, workout history, personal records, nutrition logs and settings, body measurements, readiness check-ins, achievements, custom exercises, exercise favourites and collections, and the record of which exercises you viewed. The FitWizard data on that device is erased at the same time. Deletion happens straight away and can't be undone, so download a copy first with Profile → Details → Export Data (JSON).
delete_account.guest: Not signed in? Your data is only on your device. Remove it with Profile → Details → Erase data on this device (type DELETE to confirm), or by uninstalling the app or clearing the site's data in your browser.
delete_account.by_email: Can't sign in, or don't have the app? Email {{email}} from the address on your account, with the subject 'Delete my account'. We will confirm that the address is yours and delete the account within 30 days.
delete_account.circles: If you created a circle or challenge, it stays for its other members, with you removed as its creator.
delete_account.other_devices: Other devices where you were signed in keep their copy on the device until you sign out there, or uninstall the app.
delete_account.what_may_remain: What may remain: copies in our database provider's routine backups until they expire ({{backup}}), and data already sent to the services listed above, which they keep under their own policies.

security.title: Security
security.p1: Data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS). In our cloud database, access rules let each account read and change only its own records, and the key that can delete accounts is kept only on our server. No storage is perfectly secure, so please keep your device and your email account secure too.

children.title: Children
children.p1: FitWizard is not directed at children under {{age}}, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us data, contact us and we will delete it.

contact.title: Contact

not_medical.title: Not medical advice
not_medical.p1: FitWizard gives general fitness information only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it does not replace a doctor, physiotherapist or other qualified professional. Read the Medical Disclaimer before you start training.

responsibility.title: Your responsibility
responsibility.check: Check with a healthcare professional before starting a new program, especially if you have a health condition or an injury.
responsibility.limits: Train within your limits, use good form and suitable equipment, and stop if you feel pain, dizziness or shortness of breath.
responsibility.accuracy: Enter accurate information, such as your weight or injuries, because plans and targets depend on it.
responsibility.security: Keep your device and the email account you sign in with secure.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.p1: An account is optional. To sign in, you need access to your email address. You can delete your account at any time (see Delete your account in the Privacy Policy).

acceptable_use.redistribute: copy, resell or redistribute the app, except where its licences allow.

licence.p1: You may use FitWizard for your own personal, non-commercial purposes. Exercise data comes from wger and food data from Open Food Facts. Their communities provide it under their own licences, and we cannot guarantee that it is complete or accurate.

about.title: About FitWizard
about.tagline: Smarter training plans, built around you.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: It started with the question every lifter has asked: “Am I even doing this right?”
story.spark_body: I'd stand in the gym staring at a plan full of exercise names — no picture, no clue which muscle I should feel. I wasn't short on effort. I was drowning in guesswork, and the guesswork was heavier than the weights.
story.build_body: So I stopped guessing and started building. Every exercise got a face. Every move got a target. And it all lived in my pocket, even with zero bars of signal in the back of the gym.
story.wizard_body: Then I thought about my best friend. What if they wanted to train with me — or I wanted to coach them? Progress hits different when someone's in your corner. So FitWizard grew to serve both sides of the rack: the lifter and the coach.
story.today_body: Now it's yours. No more guessing, just showing up. Whether you're chasing your first PR or guiding someone to theirs, this is built for the long game: stronger body, clearer mind, and real pride in how far you've come.

creator.fact_body: For longevity. I want my mind and body at their peak, even when I'm old. Lifting is what I love, and it brings tranquility into my world.

cta.title: Ready to take the guesswork out?
cta.body: Answer a few quick questions and get a plan built around you, in minutes.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.statement: Take the guesswork out of getting stronger, so every lifter and every coach can train with clarity, confidence and the long game in mind.
mission.tap_hint: Tap a principle to see what it means
mission.clarity_body: Every exercise shows you what it looks like and which muscles it should hit. Your energy goes into the lift, not into figuring it out.
mission.anywhere_body: Your plan lives on your device and works offline, even in the back corner of the gym with zero bars. Your data stays yours.
mission.together_body: Built for both sides of the rack. Lifters and coaches share the same page, so accountability comes naturally and nobody trains alone.
mission.longevity_body: Smart progression and recovery check-ins keep you training for years, not weeks. Progress you can be proud of, in body and mind.

credits.title: Credits & Thanks
credits.exercises: Exercise data and search powered by API Ninjas and our curated library.
credits.open_source: Built on open source: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion and Capacitor.

closing.made_with: Made with care for lifters everywhere.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: This permanently deletes your FitWizard account and everything synced to it: plans, workout history, personal records, nutrition, body measurements, readiness check-ins, achievements and custom exercises. FitWizard data on this device is erased too. This can't be undone.
delete.success: Your account and all its data have been deleted.
delete.error: We couldn't delete your account. Check your connection and try again.

erase.title: Erase data on this device?
erase.body: This removes your plans, workout history, personal records, nutrition, body measurements, readiness check-ins, achievements, custom exercises and exercise favourites from this device. You aren't signed in, so there is no cloud copy. This can't be undone.
erase.success: All FitWizard data on this device has been erased.
erase.error: We couldn't erase this device. Please try again.

consent.welcome_description: Your workout planner is ready. Before we begin, confirm these basics.
consent.diagnostics_intro: Both are off unless you turn them on. Neither one ever sends your workouts, weights, body measurements or meals.
consent.crash_reports_description: When the app hits an error, send the error details, app version, browser and device type to Sentry so we can fix it.
consent.analytics_description: Send which screens you open and which features you use (for example, that a plan was made) to PostHog (EU) and Vercel Web Analytics, with no name or email.
consent.change_later: Change these at any time in Profile → Details → Privacy Settings.
